text: 9月，两个期限买断式逆回购均为等量续作，结束此前连续两个月加量续作过程。 9月15日，中国人民银行以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（181天），到期日为2027年3月15日（遇节假日顺延）。 由于9月有5000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购到期，这意味着本月实现等量续作。此前，9月3个月期买断式逆回购也为等量续作。
text_en: In September, both tenor outright reverse repos were rolled over in equal amounts, ending the previous two consecutive months of increased-volume rollovers. On September 15, the People's Bank of China conducted a 500 billion yuan outright reverse repo operation through fixed-quantity, rate-based bidding with multiple-price allocation, with a term of 6 months (181 days) and a maturity date of March 15, 2027 (postponed in case of holidays). As 500 billion yuan of 6-month outright reverse repos matured in September, this means an equal-amount rollover was achieved this month. Previously, the 3-month outright reverse repo in September was also rolled over in an equal amount.
